data.gender_notes: Alberik is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German words 'alber' (noble) and 'ric' (ruler, power). The name Alberik is associated with nobility, power, and rule. The name Alberik carries the meaning “Noble ruler, bright ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alberik usually hope their child will grow to embody noble ruler, bright ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Alberik belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble ruler, bright ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alberik total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אלבריק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלבריק הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אצילות רוחנית' או 'כוח אלוהי'. הוא מורכב מהמילים 'אדל' שפירושה אצילות ו'בריק' שפירושה רוחנית או אלוהי. השם אלבריק משמש לעתים קרובות בקהילות נוצריות ואף מוזכר בכתבי הקודש הנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Αλβέρικος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αλβέρικος είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'αλβ' που σημαίνει φως και 'ερικ' που σημαίνει εξουσία ή δύναμη. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην αρχαία Εκκλησία και συμβολίζει τη δύναμη του φωτός ή την αγία δύναμη.

in_latin.name: Albericus
in_latin.long_meaning: Albericus is a name derived from the Germanic words 'adal' meaning noble and 'ric' meaning power or ruler. It was used in medieval Christian tradition to signify a person of noble spiritual power or a ruler with divine authority.

in_english.name: Alberik
in_english.long_meaning: Alberik is a Christian name originating from Germanic roots, specifically from the words 'adal' meaning noble and 'ric' meaning ruler or power. The name Alberik signifies a person of noble spiritual leadership or a ruler with divine authority. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing strength, nobility, and spiritual guidance.
